scope: Base game plus six official DLC; 21 string tables and UI text translation file
distribution_basis: The repository owner requested archival of a publicly distributed Korean patch's translation data.
rights_note: Local package lacks a formal license and translator attribution. Public availability alone does not prove redistribution rights; original creators retain their rights.
possible_source_context: Fallout 4 Korean community translations have been produced by Team Waldo and other reviewers, but exact contributors to this supplied 2026 package were not independently verified.
stage_location_hint: Local Morrowind mod project / work / dictionaries / fallout4_base_staged
notes: All 164201 extracted Korean entries, including per-table string IDs, were preserved unchanged in compressed JSONL. English source strings, fonts and game assets are not included. Source attribution/redistribution requests should be handled by the repository owner.
